prompt: A model's DCF workbook shows the right Enterprise Value, yet fails a perturbation criterion that changes WACC. Give a likely cause and explain why the paper treats this as an important weakness.

private.model_answer: The model probably hardcoded a value or overwrote a formula with a constant, so Enterprise Value no longer depends on WACC. The paper treats this as important because a real model must stay live when assumptions change; static correctness hides brittle workbooks that fail when analysts adjust inputs.

rubric.criterion: Identifies a plausible cause such as a hardcoded value, a constant overwriting a formula, or non-converging circularity
Explains that the output stops responding to the input so the model is not dynamically correct
Connects this to real use, where analysts change assumptions
